'''Rorgam''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose population consisted mainly of immigrants from other planets.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Many of the world's elite were known to wear wrapped cloth headpieces.
